backend/main.mo: Minimal Motoko actor with no defined methods.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report defining two green‑palette theming features and their related files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Plain-text map of frontend file paths to short summaries describing each component or config file.
frontend/index.css: Global CSS defining OKLCH-based color tokens for light and dark mode, currently using red-leaning values.
frontend/index.html: Base HTML entry point with root div and script loading the React app.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Sets up the TanStack Router with a marketing layout and two routes: landing and details pages.
frontend/src/components/marketing/Eligib: Card listing six eligibility requirements with checkmark icons and supportive text.
frontend/src/components/marketing/FaqAcc: Accordion component rendering eight FAQ items with questions and answers.
frontend/src/components/marketing/Footer: Footer with navigation links, section anchors, support links, and Caffeine.ai attribution.
frontend/src/components/marketing/HowItW: Four-step process overview displayed as icon cards with titles and descriptions.
frontend/src/components/marketing/Market: Layout wrapper combining top navigation, main content, and footer.
frontend/src/components/marketing/Sectio: Section wrapper providing spacing, optional muted background, and container layout.
frontend/src/components/marketing/TopNav: Responsive top navigation with route highlighting, mobile menu, and CTA button.
frontend/src/components/marketing/TrustS: Grid of statistic cards showing key teen freelancing metrics with icons.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates an authenticated or anonymous backend actor via React Query and refreshes dependent queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity auth context, handling identity loading, login, logout, and status tracking.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Placeholder file for future React Query hooks related to backend methods.
frontend/src/hooks/useRouteSeo.ts: Updates document title, meta tags, and canonical link based on route metadata.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind base styles with custom light/dark color variables and global accessibility rules.
frontend/src/lib/utils.ts: Exports a utility function to merge Tailwind class names using clsx and tailwind-merge.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the app with React, setting up QueryClient and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/TeenDetailsPage.tsx: Renders the detailed teen freelancing guide page with steps, safety features, and SEO setup.
frontend/src/pages/TeenLandingPage.tsx: Displays the teen landing page with hero section, benefits, and SEO configuration.
frontend/src/seo/routeMetadata.ts: Defines SEO metadata for routes and provides a helper to build canonical URLs.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration extending theme colors, typography, animations, and enabling plugins.
project_state.json: Tracks project state for a 2‑page Funngro website redesign, listing scope, SEO requirements, visual theme updates, and existing feature definitions. Notes a fix request to replace the warm red background with a calm green palette.
